input.content:
import re
import sys

root = sys.argv[1]
files = ['base.css', 'shell.css', 'library.css', 'song.css', 'practice.css']
FS = {'10.5px': 'var(--fs-2xs)', '11px': 'var(--fs-xs)', '11.5px': 'var(--fs-xs)', '12px': 'var(--fs-xs)', '12.5px': 'var(--fs-xs)', '13px': 'var(--fs-sm)', '14px': 'var(--fs-md)', '14.5px': 'var(--fs-md)', '18px': 'var(--fs-lg)'}
RAD = {'3px': 'var(--r-sm)', '4px': 'var(--r-sm)', '5px': 'var(--r-sm)', '6px': 'var(--r-sm)', '8px': 'var(--r-md)', '10px': 'var(--r-md)', '14px': 'var(--r-lg)', '999px': 'var(--r-pill)'}
total = 0
for name in files:
    p = f'{root}/{name}'
    s = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()
    n0 = s

    def fs(m):
        v = m.group(1)
        return f'font-size: {FS[v]};' if v in FS else m.group(0)

    def rad(m):
        v = m.group(1)
        return f'border-radius: {RAD[v]};' if v in RAD else m.group(0)

    def font_short(m):
        # font: <peso> <tamanho> ...  → tamanho do token
        w, size, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        return f'font: {w} {FS[size]}{rest}' if size in FS else m.group(0)

    s = re.sub(r'font-size: ([0-9.]+px);', fs, s)
    s = re.sub(r'border-radius: ([0-9.]+px);', rad, s)
    s = re.sub(r'font: (\d{3}) ([0-9.]+px)( /|;| var)', font_short, s)
    s = s.replace('var(--danger, #c62828)', 'var(--bad)')
    s = s.replace('fill: #1d1d22;', 'fill: var(--key-black);')
    s = s.replace('fill: #fff;', 'fill: var(--on-color);')
    s = s.replace('color: #fff;', 'color: var(--on-color);')
    s = s.replace("var(--stem-backing, #8b5cf6)", 'var(--stem-backing)')
    if s != n0:
        total += 1
        open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s)
        print('changed', name)

# Tokens: tamanho extra-pequeno e tinta sobre cor forte.
tp = f'{root}/tokens.css'
t = open(tp, encoding='utf-8').read()
if '--fs-2xs' not in t:
    t = t.replace('  --fs-xs: 11.5px;', '  --fs-2xs: 10.5px;\n  --fs-xs: 11.5px;', 1)
if '--on-color' not in t:
    t = t.replace('  --hand-left: #c97a12;', '  /* Texto sobre preenchimento de cor forte (tecla acesa, etiqueta da mão). */\n  --on-color: #ffffff;\n  --hand-left: #c97a12;', 1)
open(tp, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(t)
print('files changed', total)
